steps.title: Pace
steps.body: A rate limiter is proactive: pace below the source quota. Retries are reactive: use both.

steps.title: Retry
steps.body: The SDK default is one retry. Raise it to 4 or 5 against APIs that rate-limit aggressively.

steps.title: Park
steps.body: Send items that keep failing to a dead-letter queue instead of dropping them.

steps.title: Reconcile
steps.body: After an ambiguous transport failure, read state back. Never blindly repeat the write.

steps.title: Fail visibly
steps.body: Exit non-zero so the scheduler sees the failure. Use forceRestart only after a crashed run leaves an upload stuck.
